title: Packaging
summary: Interposers, HBM stacks and CoWoS: the package is now a system.

links.why: HBM stacks and CoWoS sit inside most big AI chips
advanced packaging is a chokepoint in the chain

ideas.how: HBM sits millimeters from the processor on one interposer
an interposer joins several dies into one system
as shrinking slows, joining and stacking dies carries progress

tradeoffs.how: chiplets need an interposer and fast links to act as one chip

then: Chips sit alone in their packages, wired out through bond wires or solder bumps.
2.5D packaging begins: TSMC's CoWoS joins dies side by side on a silicon interposer.
HBM memory stacks arrive beside the GPU (2015).
Chiplets and HBM stacks make the package a system.

challenges.title: Bandwidth per stack
challenges.task: Count the memory stacks around Rubin and work out how much of its 22 TB/s each one carries. How many phones of memory bandwidth is one stack?
challenges.hint: Pull the package all the way apart and select the HBM4 stacks to count them. Then divide 22 TB/s by that number.
challenges.why: Rubin has 8 HBM4 stacks, so each carries about 2.75 TB/s. A phone's whole memory delivers well under 0.1 TB/s, so one stack moves more than 25 phones' worth of data.

learn.plain: Packaging used to be just a protective case. Now it is like building a tiny city block: processor buildings next to memory towers, joined by extremely dense roads so data never travels far.
learn.engineer: CoWoS-S uses one silicon interposer; CoWoS-L embeds small silicon bridges in an organic redistribution layer to go beyond the reticle size. Micro-bump pitches are tens of micrometers while hybrid bonding goes below 10 µm. HBM4 doubles the interface to 2,048 bits, and with a foundry-made base die, customers can put custom logic under the memory stack. Heat density, warpage and testing stacks before assembly are the main yield challenges.

quiz.q: What does a silicon interposer do?
options: Connects dies side by side with very fine wiring
quiz.why: It provides far more connections than an ordinary package substrate can.

quiz.q: Why do co-packaged optics matter for AI data centers?
options: Light carries data between chips over distance with less power than copper
They remove the need for GPUs
quiz.why: Moving optics into the package cuts the power cost of linking thousands of GPUs.
